messages:
maya: Heads up — after last night's archive rotation we got RBAC alert noise from the backup-uploader role and a handful of KMS audit entries with 'grant not found'. Anyone else seeing this?
alex: Yep saw alerts at ~02:15 UTC. Looks like some snapshots failed to re-encrypt during rotation, S3 PUTs rolled back.
jordan: I pulled the audit logs, there are a bunch of KMS Deny events referencing a GRANT ID that doesn't exist anymore. Possibly grant TTL expired during the rotation window.
maya: Exact error from the uploader service: `AccessDeniedException: MissingGrantToken: grant not found` in the upload path.
ops-bot: :warning: alert: backup-uploader-service failed 24 uploads in the last hour (rate 0.4/min). See /incidents/backup-uploads for details.
sre_lead: Can someone paste the minimal repro? also which CMK was targeted, and whether this is the cross-account grant flow.
alex: Repro snippet from staging uploader logs: ```json
{"time":"2024-04-01T02:14:23Z","err":"MissingGrantToken","cmk":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"}```
jordan: Confirmed CMK arn above. The grant ID referenced in CloudTrail is `g-9a12b3c4`. CloudTrail shows the grant was created 30 days ago and TTL set to 7 days (weird).
maya: Who set grant TTL to 7d? That should be default infinite for the uploader role. This smells like a config drift from the RBAC/infra change last month.
security-bot: Note: policy change #PR-482 (applied 2024-03-02) updated the `backup-uploader` role creation script. It added a `grant_ttl` env var for temp grants to support short-lived restore jobs.
alex: Aha — the new infra template is used for archives too but archive rotation expects long-lived grants. So during rotation the grant expired mid-flight and uploads using the older grant failed.
sre_lead: Action plan: 1) short-term rollback: create a new grant with proper canonical policy and attach to uploader role for affected CMKs. 2) mid-term: change infra templates so rotation jobs create ephemeral grants only for restore jobs, not archive uploads. 3) long-term: add audit alert correlation so KMS Deny + grant-delete spikes map to RBAC template changes.
jordan: I created a temporary grant and manually requeued failed uploads — they're progressing now. Command used: ```aws kms create-grant --key-id abcd-ef01 --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/backup-uploader --operations Encrypt Decrypt --name "uploader-temp-grant"```
maya: Thanks — uploads resumed, seeing successful 200s. Can we get a quick hotfix to prevent TTL override?
alex: I'll open a PR to pin the default to `null` unless explicitly set, and add a unit test for the template.
security-bot: Compliance note: need to log the manual grant creation and tie it to an audit ticket. Requesting a retention record for 90 days for this CMK audit trail.
sre_lead: Jordan — please add an entry to the incident tracker with timeline and link to PR after it's open. Maya — can you coordinate a post-mortem to include action owners?
maya: Will do. I'll draft a short postmortem and include recommended RBAC guardrails: prevent grant_ttl in archive-related templates, and add a pre-rotation dry-run that validates active grants.
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: backup uploads healthy. 0 failures in the last 10 minutes.
jordan: FYI, I also noticed the KMS audit logs don't surface grant-ttl changes clearly. Filing a ticket to improve the audit parser so we can trigger alerts when TTLs are reduced on CMKs used by long-running jobs.
alex: +1. Also adding a CI check that flags any new infra template that introduces `grant_ttl` for roles marked `archive` or `persistent`.
maya: Great. Thanks everyone — logging action items now and will set a 24h follow-up. :thumbsup:
security-bot: Reminder: attach manual grant creation to ticket SEC-2024-112 and include CloudTrail IDs for traceability.
